sources.head: Vyanzo
sources.waits: Safu zinazoongezwa na chanzo husubiri hapa uzikubali.
sources.request: Soma hiki: {what}. Kwa kila kimoja ambacho mkusanyiko “{name}” ({place}) bado hauna, ongeza safu ndani yake yenye kile kinachosema. Usibadilishe safu nyingine yoyote.
sources.fileRequest: Ikiwa faili hili ni la aina hii: {what}, liongezee safu kwenye mkusanyiko “{name}” ({place}) yenye kile linachosema. Usibadilishe safu nyingine yoyote. Ikiwa sivyo, usifanye chochote.
